title: Houston QB Conner Weigman out with undisclosed injury for No. 20 Cougars' game at West Virginia

 Houston QB Conner Weigman out with undisclosed injury for No. 20 Cougars' game at West Virginia
 Houston quarterback Conner Weigman hands off the ball in the first half of an NCAA college football game against Colorado Friday, Nov. 13, 2026, in Boulder, Colo. Credit: AP/David Zalubowski
 By The Associated Press November 21, 2026 1:24 pm Share MORGANTOWN, W.Va. — Houston quarterback Conner Weigman was ruled out of the 20th-ranked Cougars' matchup against West Virginia on Saturday with an undisclosed injury. 
 Weigman was in street clothes watching his teammates warm up prior to the game. Freshman Keisean Henderson got his first start in Weigman's place. Weigman had been listed as a game-time decision. 
 Weigman has thrown for 2,552 yards with 25 touchdowns and three interceptions this season. Last week he threw for 272 yards and three touchdowns with an interception in a 42-32 loss at Colorado.
 A five-star recruit, Henderson is a dual-threat quarterback who was ranked by some publications as the top recruit in the nation after throwing for 6,415 yards and 76 touchdowns and running for 661 yards and 14 scores in four high school seasons. 
 Henderson appeared in two games earlier this season. He completed 6 of 8 passes for 83 yards and two touchdowns while rushing for a 54-yard TD on his only carry.
